title: Work Map integration post-allocation repair root

phases.objective: Allow the active Spec Kit Work Map Integration workflow to parse and accept workflow_dispatch by deferring runner.temp-derived repair-root initialization until after runner allocation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: workflow_dispatch of spec-kit-work-map-integration.yml on an exact generated branch head
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: GitHub accepts the dispatch, allocates the runner, initializes the bounded repair directory through RUNNER_TEMP, and starts read-only integration validation.
steps: Parse the active workflow without evaluating runner.temp at job registration time.
Initialize WORK_MAP_REPAIR_ROOT from RUNNER_TEMP through GITHUB_ENV.
Checkout and validate the exact requested branch head.
Run Work Map currentness and governance checks without repository writes.
assertions: WORK_MAP_REPAIR_ROOT is absent from job-level env.
The repair root is initialized after runner allocation.
The repair candidate remains bounded to the runner temporary directory.
The integration workflow retains contents:read only.

phases.objective: Preserve the existing exact-head Work Map integration and repair-candidate behavior while removing only the pre-run expression defect.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow continues to check generated maps, creates a local repair candidate only when stale, uploads read-only evidence, and fails closed without committing or pushing.
steps: Validate the canonical Work Map modules and connectivity.
Check generated Work Maps for currentness.
When stale, generate only beneath docs/work-maps in the runner workspace.
Upload the bounded candidate and fail closed.
Run schema and governance regressions when current.
assertions: No commit, push, force push, protected-ref mutation, Runtime contact, deployment, database action, provider action, SQL, or Migration Apply is introduced.
Step-level runner.temp use for artifact upload remains valid.

phases.objective: Prevent regression to job-level runner.temp evaluation and keep invalid registration fail-closed before any repository or external mutation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: candidate changes to the Work Map integration workflow
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Executable regression rejects any return of WORK_MAP_REPAIR_ROOT to job-level runner.temp and requires bounded post-allocation initialization.
steps: Require the named post-allocation initialization step.
Require RUNNER_TEMP, GITHUB_ENV, cleanup, and directory creation bindings.
Retain the read-only integration workflow boundary.
assertions: The workflow remains dispatchable and read-only.
The repair directory is deterministic and runner-scoped.
No secrets are included and no external system is contacted.

phases.objective: This repository validation repair has no provider canary authority.
This repository validation repair performs no Production action or deployment.
